Try To Look Like Another Equal-length Variable

Source: R/mimic.R
mimic.default.Rd

Tries to mimic another vector or factor. If meaningful and possible, x acquires a guide attribute with labels from corresponding values in y. Any codelist attribute is removed. No guide is created for zero-length x. If x is a factor, unused levels are removed.

Usage

# Default S3 method
mimic(x, y = x, ...)

Arguments

x

vector-like

y

vector-like, same length as x

...

passed to link{factor}

Value

same class as x

See also

Other mimic: mimic(), mimic.classified()

Other interface: canonical.decorated(), classified.data.frame(), decorate.character(), decorate.data.frame(), desolve.decorated(), enscript.decorated(), ggplot.decorated(), io_csv.character(), io_csv.data.frame(), io_res.character(), io_res.decorated(), io_table.character(), io_table.data.frame(), io_yamlet.character(), io_yamlet.data.frame(), is_parseable.default(), modify.default(), promote.list(), read_yamlet(), resolve.decorated(), selected.default(), write_yamlet()

Examples

library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
let <- letters[1:5]
LET <- LETTERS[1:5]
int <- 0L:4L
num <- as.numeric(int)
fac <- factor(let)
css <- classified(let)

# any of these can mimic any other
str(mimic(LET, let))
#>  chr [1:5] "A" "B" "C" "D" "E"
#>  - attr(*, "guide")=List of 5
#>   ..$ a: chr "A"
#>   ..$ b: chr "B"
#>   ..$ c: chr "C"
#>   ..$ d: chr "D"
#>   ..$ e: chr "E"
str(mimic(num, let))
#>  num [1:5] 0 1 2 3 4
#>  - attr(*, "guide")=List of 5
#>   ..$ a: num 0
#>   ..$ b: num 1
#>   ..$ c: num 2
#>   ..$ d: num 3
#>   ..$ e: num 4
str(mimic(let, num))
#>  chr [1:5] "a" "b" "c" "d" "e"
#>  - attr(*, "guide")=List of 5
#>   ..$ 0: chr "a"
#>   ..$ 1: chr "b"
#>   ..$ 2: chr "c"
#>   ..$ 3: chr "d"
#>   ..$ 4: chr "e"

# factors get a guide and classifieds get a named codelist
str(mimic(fac, int))
#>  Factor w/ 5 levels "a","b","c","d",..: 1 2 3 4 5
#>  - attr(*, "guide")=List of 5
#>   ..$ 0: chr "a"
#>   ..$ 1: chr "b"
#>   ..$ 2: chr "c"
#>   ..$ 3: chr "d"
#>   ..$ 4: chr "e"
str(mimic(css, int))
#>  Factor w/ 5 levels "a","b","c","d",..: 1 2 3 4 5
#>  - attr(*, "codelist")=List of 5
#>   ..$ 0: chr "a"
#>   ..$ 1: chr "b"
#>   ..$ 2: chr "c"
#>   ..$ 3: chr "d"
#>   ..$ 4: chr "e"

# int can 'pick up' the factor levels as guide names
str(mimic(int, css))
#>  int [1:5] 0 1 2 3 4
#>  - attr(*, "guide")=List of 5
#>   ..$ a: int 0
#>   ..$ b: int 1
#>   ..$ c: int 2
#>   ..$ d: int 3
#>   ..$ e: int 4

# if two variables mean essentially the same thing,
# mimic lets you save space
x <- data.frame(id = 1:2, ID = c('A','B'))
x
#>   id ID
#> 1  1  A
#> 2  2  B
x %<>% mutate(id = mimic(id, ID)) %>% select(-ID)
x
#>   id
#> 1  1
#> 2  2
# ID still available, in principle:
x %>% as_decorated %>% resolve
#>   id
#> 1  A
#> 2  B
